Karutha Rathrikal
Karutha Rathrikal ("Dark Nights") is a 1967 Indian Malayalam-language science fiction film. An adaptation of the novel "Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde" by Robert Louis Stevenson, it was the first science fiction film in the history of Malayalam cinema.
